bind_address.description: IP address to bind the GKrellM server daemon to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

bind_port.description: TCP port on which gkrellmd will listen for client connections.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for client connections.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to syslog instead.

data_refresh_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds between updates of monitored data.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

users.description: List of user accounts allowed to connect. Each user must specify a name, password, and permissions.

password.description: Password for login (stored in plaintext; use strong access controls for this file).

permissions.description: Access permissions: 'read' (view only) or 'control' (read + manage monitors).

snmp_enabled.description: Enable SNMP monitoring of remote devices.

snmp_community.description: Default SNMP community string for read access (v1/v2c only).

snmp_hosts.description: List of SNMP hosts to monitor.

hostname.description: IP address or hostname of the SNMP device.

community.description: SNMP community string for this host (optional; uses global default if omitted).

version.description: SNMP version: '1', '2c', or '3' (v3 requires additional configuration not supported by this template).

ups_enabled.description: Enable UPS monitoring via apcupsd or NUT.

ups_host.description: Hostname or IP of NUT UPS daemon (only used if ups_type='nut').

ups_port.description: Port of NUT UPS daemon (only used if ups_type='nut').

ups_name.description: UPS device name registered with NUT (only used if ups_type='nut').

mysql_enabled.description: Enable built-in MySQL server monitoring (status variables, uptime, etc.).

mysql_host.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address.

mysql_user.description: MySQL user with REPLICATION CLIENT and PROCESS privileges.

mysql_database.description: Database name (not required; monitoring uses global status variables).

pg_host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname, IP, or path to Unix socket directory.

pg_user.description: PostgreSQL user with sufficient privileges to query pg_stat_database.

apache_enabled.description: Enable built-in Apache web server monitoring (requires mod_status with 'server-status' enabled).

apache_status_url.description: Full URL to Apache server-status page (must end in '?auto' for auto-parsing).

ntp_server.description: NTP server to query for time offset and status.

monitor_disks.description: Monitor disk space usage for local filesystems.

monitor_process_list.description: List of processes to monitor individually.

name.description: Display name for the monitored process.

cmdline.description: Regular expression or full command-line to match (case-sensitive).
